summary.text: S HOLAND BILVERKSTED AS (928 260 127), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1975-08-06; address 9440 EVENSKJER, Norge. Main industry is Repair and maintenance of motor vehicles (95.310); 24 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Solveig Grete Edvardsen; Board chair: Svein Johan Holand; Auditor: HRH REVISJON AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 24.27 m, operating profit NOK 148.87 k, net profit NOK 142.69 k, equity NOK 10.70 m, total assets NOK 14.92 m.
